posts.title: Price of Insecurity: Why Most Companies Choose To Be Insecure
posts.description: Corporate insecurity has persisted for decades for reasons unrelated to technology. For most companies, the rational business choice has been to prioritize revenue growth over security engineering. To explain what happened, I am narrating a short video that interprets the incident in terms of human incentives and security engineering.
